answer: Jittered Arrival Budget: each identity gets an encrypted arrival-time budget that decays like a dune crest under wind; agents must spread actions across windows, and bursts beyond the norm trigger quarantine. A comet of cloned accounts arriving together is throttled because their combined traffic shape exceeds the per-epoch envelope. Honest users pay a small delay, while an attacker pays a fresh bandwidth-shaped history per clone, umber with retries.
